name: stage7_dense_week_with_24h_gap_v0
description: Stage 7 fixture v1 — full README acceptance shape: 10-turn real-week conversation -> 24h+ gap -> 3 question turns. Same content as stage7_dense_week.json but with explicit per-turn event-time via turn_offsets_seconds. Exercises time-decay (luna-runtime/decay): the 40-hour gap between turn 10 and turn 11 produces a measurable forgotten_risk on episodes that haven't been reinforced since day 1. With the 7-day default half-life, day-1 episodes show ~0.45 forgotten_risk by the question turns; the recall_gate attenuates their score by ~11%. Decay events appear in the log under EpisodeDecayed kind. Pair to stage7_dense_week.json: that fixture verifies dense-recall under LLM extraction; this fixture verifies the same under realistic time-decay.
